venue: Our Lady of Lourdes Stadium (Cajun Field)
summary: Best elevated game-day view is from 2009, taken from the west side looking at the unchanged east stands; no post-renovation (2025) interior photo exists. No night photo.

files.author: Jcarriere (talk)
files.credit_line: Photo: Jcarriere (talk), CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Elevated west-side (press box level) view straight across the 50 to the east stands, 2009 game with full crowd and the band on the field; field rows ~520-1530 of 1800 (29-85%), crowded east stands rows 0-520, home fans' backs in the bottom ~15%. Pre-2024/25 renovation photo: the renovation rebuilt the west side (behind the camera) and north end; the east stands shown are unchanged, field graphics have changed

closest_misses.why: Current-era (Sept 2024) elevated corner panorama, empty stadium, field rows ~55-80%, sky fills the top 45%
Sept 2024 view of the away (east) stands from a low corner, empty; sky top 40%
